steps.en: OCMS picks up the court outcome file
steps.id: OCMS mengambil file hasil dari pengadilan
steps.why_en: No court outcome file transfer or scheduled job exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada transfer file hasil pengadilan atau job terjadwal.

steps.en: Rejected applications are picked out and processed
steps.id: Aplikasi yang ditolak dipilah dan diproses
steps.why_en: No logic reads or handles rejected court applications.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logic yang membaca atau menangani aplikasi court yang ditolak.

steps.en: The rejection reason is saved on the record
steps.why_en: A reason field exists but nothing saves a rejection reason into it.
steps.why_id: Ada field alasan tetapi tidak ada yang mengisi alasan penolakan.

steps.en: The record is marked approved or rejected
steps.why_en: There is no approved/rejected marker in the data model.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penanda disetujui/ditolak di model data.

steps.en: The record goes back to its earlier stage
steps.why_en: Only a caller-supplied stage overwrite exists; no revert on rejection.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada penimpaan stage dari pemanggil; tidak ada revert saat ditolak.

steps.en: The record is released from its batch
steps.why_en: No batch number exists on the backend record to clear.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada nomor batch di record backend untuk dihapus.
